{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "closed_shell_ionicity_gap_prior",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "closed_shell_halide_insulator",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "halide", "transition_metal_flag": "no_transition_metal"},
          "weight": 0.8,
          "rationale": "Ionic halides without partly filled d states have widest gaps; large electronegativity contrast maximizes valence-conduction separation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "main_group_oxide_insulator",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "oxide", "transition_metal_flag": "no_transition_metal"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Main-group oxides are insulators: deep O 2p valence bands with empty cation s conduction states."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_chalcogenide_covalent_narrowing",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "chalcogenide"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Heavy chalcogen p states raise valence-band maxima covalently, giving narrow semiconducting gaps; also the largest candidate block."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "metalloid_polarizable_narrow_gap",
          "conditions": {"dominant_family": "metalloid"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Highest-confidence source relation (+9.23 on refractive index); by Moss scaling, high polarizability implies narrow gap."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.3,
      "prior_scale": 0.38,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.4,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.1,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.72,
      "hypothesis": "Ionicity plus closed-shell cation chemistry drives wide experimental gaps, with one sign-reversed high-confidence source relation for metalloids. May fail for defect-narrowed halides or wide-gap sulfides such as ZnS."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "d0_d10_oxide_counter_hypothesis",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "transition_metal_oxide_wide_gap",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "oxide", "transition_metal_flag": "has_transition_metal"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Counter to blanket d-state penalty: d0/d10 oxides (TiO2, ZrO2, ZnO) are archetypal wide-gap insulators."
        },
